beats.summary: Michael is honored as a visiting professor and guest speaker in Ryan's Emerging Enterprises business school class.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Today's a special day, because I am being honored as a… visiting… professor, special lecturer, emeritus…
Ryan: You will be a guest speaker… in my Emerging Enterprises class.

beats.summary: Pam is back together with Roy and preparing for her art show, which she invites coworkers to attend.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I'm really happy to be back with Roy. I think it shows maturity.

beats.summary: A bat is loose in the office, causing chaos and concern among the employees.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: We have… a bat… in the office.
Angela: Poop is raining from the ceilings. Poop!

beats.summary: Michael gives an inspirational and humorous speech to the business school class, ripping pages from a textbook to emphasize life lessons.
Jim experiences a strange sensation after a bat bite, feeling 'strangely powerful' despite no visible mark.

evidence.snippet: Jim: The bat, I mean, I know I felt it bite me, but look. There's no mark. I feel so… tingly… so strangely powerful…

notable_quotes.quote: May your hats fly as high as your dreams.
notable_quotes.speaker: Michael

evidence.snippet: Michael: Yeah, I know, I know. I'm just saying if they did throw their hats I've got a great line for that: "May your hats fly as high as your dreams."
Dwight: "Don't be an idiot." Changed my life.

notable_quotes.quote: You cannot learn from books. Replace these pages with life lessons, and then, you will have… a book… that is worth its weight in gold.
